sla: Our goal is to reply within 5 business days.

submitted.label: Received
submitted.text: We got your package. It enters the automatic check in a moment.

validating.label: Checking
validating.text: We're checking the package's format, steps and knowledge. It only takes a few minutes.

rejected_validation.label: Has errors
rejected_validation.text: The automatic check found errors. Fix what's listed below and upload the package again. Nothing has gone to the team's review.

pending_review.label: In the review queue
pending_review.text: The team will read the whole package. {sla}

changes_requested.label: Changes requested
changes_requested.text: The team asked for changes. Read the note below, fix the package and upload it again: the version stays the same.

rejected.label: Declined
rejected.text: The team did not approve this package. The reason is below. You can upload a new package whenever you like.

awaiting_creator_signature.label: Needs your confirmation
awaiting_creator_signature.textUpdate: The team approved the new version. You just need to sign the update once with your account (Solvers pays the network fee).
awaiting_creator_signature.textRegister: The team approved your solver. You just need to sign once with your account to publish it (Solvers pays the network fee).

awaiting_onchain_approval.label: Final approval
awaiting_onchain_approval.text: You've already confirmed. The team still needs to give the final approval on the network, with an offline key, for the solver to appear on the storefront. You don't need to do anything.

publishing.label: Publishing
publishing.text: We're putting the solver live. It takes a few moments.

publish_failed.label: Publishing stalled
publish_failed.text: Publishing didn't finish. The team has been notified and will try again. You don't need to do anything.

published.label: Live
published.text: The solver is published on the storefront.

superseded.label: Superseded
superseded.text: There is a newer version of this solver. This one is no longer the live version.

suspended.label: Suspended
suspended.text: The platform suspended this solver. Contact the team to find out why.

withdrawn.label: Withdrawn
withdrawn.text: This solver was removed from the storefront at the creator's request.

sign.title: Your confirmation
sign.text: You sign the listing or the new version once with your account.

final.title: Final approval
final.text: New solvers only: the team approves it on the network with an offline key, outside the site.

publish.title: Publishing
publish.text: The solver goes live on the storefront.

stageState.skipped: does not apply to this update

aborted.title: Upload canceled
aborted.text: Nothing was uploaded. Choose the file and try again.

network.title: The connection dropped
network.text: The upload was interrupted before it finished. Check your internet and try again.

unauthorized.title: Your session expired
unauthorized.text: Sign in again and upload the file once more.

forbidden.title: Your profile can't upload yet
forbidden.text: Complete your creator profile (invite, terms and contact) before uploading.

conflict.title: This version already exists
conflict.text: There is already an upload or a published version with that name and version. Bump the version in the manifest and upload again.

tooLarge.title: The file is too large
tooLarge.text: The limit is 50 MB. Remove files that aren't part of the package (heavy images, copies) and zip it again.

rateLimited.title: You've reached the upload limit
rateLimited.text: You can have at most 3 uploads in progress and 5 per day. Wait for a review to finish or try again tomorrow.

rejected.title: The server didn't accept the file
rejected.text: Check that it's a ZIP with manifest.json at the root and try again.

serverError.title: The server didn't respond properly
serverError.text: Nothing was lost. Try again in a moment.

loadError.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again.
loadError.forbidden: You don't have access to this page.
loadError.serverError: The server isn't responding right now. Try again in a moment.

list.authTitle: Sign in to see your submissions
list.authText: Here you can follow every package you've uploaded: check, review and publishing.
list.emptyTitle: You haven't uploaded any packages yet
list.emptyText: Build the package with the Solver Builder and upload the ZIP. Progress shows up here.
list.notice: {sla} You'll get a notice when the team replies.
list.heading: Your submissions
list.footer: Want a new solver or a new version? Every upload goes through the same steps.

detail.authTitle: Sign in to see this submission
detail.authText: Only the person who uploaded the package can see its progress.
detail.missingText: This submission doesn't exist or doesn't belong to your account.
detail.liveTitle: The solver is live on the storefront
detail.liveText: Buyers can already find and use this version.
detail.validationPending: The result shows up here as soon as the check finishes.
detail.validationNone: This submission doesn't have a check result yet.
detail.resubmitChangesText: The fixed package goes in under the same version and returns to the automatic check.
detail.resubmitDefaultText: Fix the errors below, build the ZIP again and upload it. If the version already exists, bump the number in manifest.json.
detail.deadline: Timing: our goal is to reply within 5 business days after the package passes the automatic check.

parts.validationOk: The automatic check found no errors or warnings.
parts.errorsTitle: {n, plural, one {# error to fix} other {# errors to fix}}
parts.warningsNote: Warnings don't block the upload, but the reviewer will see every one. Fixing them now speeds up approval.
